decision: Abilities are held: not in the next batch, switched off, and they wait until a player reaches 99 in a combat skill.

decision: Endgame content past 110 is several separate maps with their own look and rule, not one map that goes deeper.

decision: There is one server-wide guild/community, not competing guilds; founding, tags and guild leaderboards are out.

decision: The game plan is an internal roadmap only and never appears on The Road Ahead.

decision: Server-wide, all-levels world events narrated by CASINO, like the Yard raid, are the direction for new features.

decision: A lost Flood leaves the water up and the stalls shut for 2 hours; the casino itself stays open.

decision: The Jackpot Thief never spawns in the Yard, carries 30,000-50,000 tickets, and his health scales with how many fight him.

decision: Major updates ship once a week, each with a weekly wiki issue (weeks start Thursday, from 1 October).

decision: Combat feel comes from drawn effects, not real attack animation frames.

decision: Long-game content is planned for players reaching levels 100-120 over many hours of play.
quote: think long term - users getting into levels 100-120, which takes many many many hours

decision: The gem bag, the Gem Sorter and Tinkering open on the live server.

decision: Big updates are built piece by piece on the local dev server and go to production only when the whole update is called.

quote: push it with depths and jewelcrafting held shut

decision: Jewelcrafting is the third new skill, after Breeding and Fungiculture.

decision: Each new map gets its own unique tile set, found by the owner, and is asked about before it is built.

decision: Power creep must be felt on new maps: some monsters are bow-only or shrug off a style or element, hit hard and are tanky, and bosses hit harder than the Pumpkin King.

decision: Pets can be traded between players or sold.

decision: A breeding pen's trough is filled once at the start; the clock then runs untouched, offline included.

decision: Eggs are rare but not that rare: about one kill in 3,000.
quote: RARE but not that rare

decision: A harvested seed crop returns a seed 25% of the time.

decision: A harvested seed crop always gives its seed back, plus a second one some of the time.

decision: Everyone gets 25 inventory slots and 5 bank pages to start.

decision: Magic has five elements with monster weaknesses and resists; gem arrows carry no element.

decision: Magic is open from level 1, with its content in mid and late areas.
Wizardry also prints utility pages, starting with eight.

decision: Some monsters are immune or mostly immune to a fighting style (e.g. ghosts take 90% less melee).

decision: Backups and a written revert procedure are on the pre-launch checklist.

decision: The next day's focus is a mobile pass, alongside backups and a world map.

decision: The combat level is the culmination of the stronger style, the weaker style and health.

decision: Pets differ by effect (speed, yield, luck, carry), never by skill, so nobody swaps pets per skill.

decision: A reforge belongs to the item and travels with it.

decision: The jukebox's radio plays on every map.
